nudge.title: Stay in the loop
nudge.message: Enable notifications to get updates on events, invitations and payments.

attendance.title: Record Attendance
attendance.body: Tap on members to mark them as attended or absent. Your records will be saved automatically.

payments.title: Payment Tracking
payments.body: Here you can see who has paid and who hasn't. Send reminders to members with outstanding fees.

createEvent.title: Create Your First Event
createEvent.body: Tap the + button to create a training session or match. Members will be notified automatically.

manageGroup.title: Group Management
manageGroup.body: Here you can add or remove members, assign roles, and organize subgroups.

news.title: News
news.body: Stay up to date with the latest announcements and updates from your club and groups.

eventResponse.title: Respond to Events
eventResponse.body: Let your coach know if you can attend by tapping the response buttons below.

statistics.title: Attendance Statistics
statistics.body: View detailed attendance patterns to understand participation trends over time.

createNews.title: Share News
createNews.body: Tap the + button to create a news post. All group members will be notified.

subgroups.title: Subgroups
subgroups.body: Create subgroups to organize members within your group — for example, by age or skill level.

coachMarks.clubEventFab: Create events & annual meetings at the club level
